svg.title: Field-level causal graph, three competing edge-sets
svg.desc: Three banded edge-sets over oversight-infrastructure nodes: corrosive capture where industry pressure weakens remedies, classification reform, and rule-setting; constructive capture where safety-coded incumbents capture safety rules and erode capacity and compulsion; and fourth-quadrant executive political capture where procurement pressure chills guardrails and whistleblower channel value, with the classified-deployment gap marked as an unpopulated node. Line style encodes observability.
svg.text: Constructive capture — incumbents capture safety rules
